summary.tldr: Removes the National Defence Act offence of maiming or injuring oneself or another person to become unfit for service.
what_it_does: Repeals the National Defence Act offence of maiming or injuring oneself or another person to render oneself or that other person unfit for service.
who_it_affects: People subject to the National Defence Act
summary.background: The bill changes section 98 of the National Defence Act. It removes paragraph (c) from that section.
